releases.notes:
This release contains minor bugfixes for LighterEnd across all supported Minecraft versions (1.21.5-26.3):

- Umbrella tree saplings, end lotus seeds and polypores are now compostable (see: #121)
  - Credit to @HP-network for PRing the fix for 26.2 and prior in https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/pull/125
- The advancement for crafting spectral arrows from LighterEnd materials now behaves as intended (in that it wasn't working at all before) (see: #122)
- The Matchstick and End Lever item textures have been re-done so that neither looks like a torch any longer (#123)
- All pre-26.3 builds should now have their metadata set correctly in `fabric.mod.json` so that Fabric Loader will tell you when you're trying to use the wrong build of Lighter End for your Minecraft

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/compare/v1.0.7...v1.0.8

releases.notes:
This release adds support for Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2, giving most modded blocks sulfur cube archetypes, and making it so that the new bouncy bois spawn in sulfur springs biomes.

It also shows some love to the older versions, going back and adding bugfixes and translations to all versions going back to 1.21.5. The older Minecraft versions have skipped a few releases, so make sure to check out [the prior release notes as well](https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/releases).

## What's Changed
- #110 Integration with the [Fox Nap](https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/FoxNap) mod is now implemented in LighterEnd (26.1/26.2 only)
- #107 The mod has been fully translated to Russian by @Yugeniele
- Bugfix: Aurous Ice (the gold stuff) was missing the "ICE" block tag
- #113 geyers now produce far fewer particles
- starter chests are given more opportunities to generate for versions supporting the experimental "Spawn in The End" game mode (that would be 1.21.9+)
- The 26.2 build has a new config option (enabled by default) to silence some annoying logspam about "unsafe terrain reads."

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.6

releases.notes: This is the [third Beta](https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/milestone/5) of LighterEnd, available for Minecraft 1.21.5 and 1.21.6-8. Since [the last milestone](https://github.com/OpenBagTwo/LighterEnd/releases/tag/v0.2.0), LighterEnd has added a new mob, a new pseudo-biome and a bunch of new features and structures that should now make it so a player never has to leave The End. ## What's New - The **Chorus Crab** is a neutral mob that spawns in Blossom Forests and Megalakes. These gentle giants can be bred with Chorus Flowers, and killing them drops **Crab Meat** and **Craw Claws,** the latter of which can be used to craft Shears, which is easily the most important tool in **LighterEnd**. - If you've been following along with LighterEnd's development, you'll note that this mob's aesthetics are vastly improved since its first introduction in v0.2.1, all thanks to a model designed by **Pegnok** of the BetterX Discord - Many crafting recipes that require cobblestone now have alternatives that can be crafted with End Stone. These include the specially textured **End Furnaces**, **End Smokers** and **End Levers** but also just the ability to craft regular Droppers, Dispensers, Observers and Pistons using End Stone - While traveling through The End, you may come across an **Obelisk**. . These serve as checkpoints for the new **Totems of Teleportation**, which can be found at **Obelisks** (and farmed from the **Trial Chambers** below). A **Totem of Teleportation** can be bound by right clicking on any **Obelisk**. Then, as long as that totem is in the player's hand or off-hand, the player will be teleported back to that checkpoint were they otherwise to die. - This even works to save a player that's fallen into The Void! - You may have also noticed that BetterEnd's **Chandeliers** can now be found in **Obelisk Trial Chambers**. They can also be crafted by combining Lumecorn Rods with Iron or Gold (or soon Copper!) - **Ice Stars** have been reimagined for LighterEnd as a source of precious metals. The three flavors of stars (copper, iron and gold) can be found rarely in void biomes (_e.g._ End Barrens) or in large concentrations in the rare **Starfield** biome. - Be aware: the colored ices found in the outer layers of these stars can be mined with any pickaxe (no Silk Touch required) and can then be smelted down into their respective nuggets - **Aurora Crystals** and the three varieties of **Jadestone** now naturally generate in the world - with **Jadestone** now being mineable with any pickaxe instead of requiring an iron tool. - **Redstone** and **Quartz Ores** can now be set to generate in The End. This feature is _off by default,_ but toggling it on in your LighterEnd config will allow you to craft a large variety of decorative blocks and technical components without ever leaving The End. - LighterEnd now has **Advancements** that should hopefully be useful for guiding players through the mod without them needing to consult the source code (or eventual Wiki #16) ### Bugfixes - Hanging Signs now have the correct GUI, (#60) thanks to contributions by @Foozey - Breaking an end wood Ladder would not drop the ladder (#69) - It's also now more efficient to break an end wood ladder with an axe - Trap Doors now have the correct recipe shape ...
